newsitem.title: USA: Strong U.S home sales fresh sign of robust economy.
newsitem.headline: Strong U.S home sales fresh sign of robust economy.

text.p: U.S. existing home sales surged in February, contributing more evidence of healthy consumer demand and a robust economy, analysts said.

The annual rate of existing home sales grew 9.0 percent last month to 4.26 million units, the second-highest rise on record. It was up from a 3.91-million-unit rate in January and exceeded the consensus forecast for 4.05 million.

"It's a reflection of the healthy economy that we've been seeing," said Kim Rupert, senior economist at MMS International Inc. "It's too early to tell whether we're going to see any real resurgence in housing activity."
